topic: Pick a mobile plan for the family

scenario.topic: Pick a mobile plan for the family
scenario.opening_question: What matters most for our family’s mobile plan: cost, data, or flexibility?

options.name: Unlimited Data Plan with Family Discounts
options.upside: No worries about running out of data for any family member
options.tradeoff: Highest monthly cost close to budget limit
options.concern: May pay for more data than actually used
options.best_for: families prioritizing unlimited data and coverage

options.name: Shared 30GB Data Plan with Moderate Cost
options.upside: Affordable plan with decent data for average use
options.tradeoff: Data can run out quickly if usage spikes
options.concern: May require monitoring data usage closely
options.best_for: families wanting balance between cost and data

options.name: Individual 10GB Plans with Flexible Add-Ons
options.upside: Each member controls own data, avoiding overuse by others
options.tradeoff: Less data per person compared to unlimited plans
options.concern: Could be inconvenient to manage multiple add-ons
options.best_for: families needing individual control and moderate data

options.name: Basic Talk and Text Plan with Low Cost
options.upside: Lowest cost plan, good for minimal data users
options.tradeoff: Very limited data and slower network speeds
options.concern: May not support streaming or heavy app use
options.best_for: families focused on calls and texts with minimal data

shared_context: Monthly budget for mobile plans is capped at $120
Everyone needs reliable coverage and at least moderate data
